data.text:
Did you know? I opened a beach hut the other day!
Houston, do you read me?
Geez! I get that swaying in the hammock is the best ever, but it's not nice to half-listen when a girl's talking!
Ya sure about your attitude here? I mean, right now, you could have sexy Aki-chan all to yourself...
Who knows if you'll get a chance like this ever again... Isn't it a waste to just fall asleep?
Pfft, ahaha! Just kidding~♪ I teased you because I wanted a bit of attention. My bad!
So...shall we continue our little private chat?
How to add a splash of color to summer you say? Leave it to me.♪
Have a taste of my swimsuit aura~♪ Mwah~♡ ...Oh wait, was that a bit too intense for you?
Both of these drinks are MINE!♪ Heehee~♪ Just kidding, here's your share!
Ya know, I was dozing off a bit earlier too~♪ But, keep it a secret between us, okay?
Wanna go down to the shoreline? Sure, big sis here will go with you.
Talk about relaxation maxxing~♪ Let's come back here again for some spiritual healing sessions. Of course, together with me!

Uhyooo, this feels sooo good~♪
I thought summer was all about lazing around in my room, but just soaking in the water is pretty much top tier, too~♪
It would be perfect if you could smile gently like before...while you also coldly insult me~♪
Hm? Whazzat? You've brought some ice-cold watermelon for me?!
A job well done! Hurry up, bring it here!
Oh, by the way, could you also pass me some cold juice? A-And make sure it's the fizzy kind!
Follow me! Those pesky humans are exhausted by the heat so...it's the perfect chance to enact WORLD DOMINATION!
I-It's not like I put on a swimsuit j-just for you or anything! Well...? Is it tsuntsun enough for your heart to melt?
Aaah, this is heaven~♪ Hey, hey, fan me with that fan!
Ugh, my hair's totally soaked! Well, it'll dry if I leave it under this scorching heat...
You're a lifesaver! Now I don't even have to use a hairdryer myself!
So sleepy~ How can I get this tired from just playing? Hey, you! Take me to my room!

Ugh...! It's really the peak of summer, huh?
I seriously can't go anywhere without my portable fan...
Hm? What's up? Oh! Is that watermelon juice?!
Is that for me? Wow, you're a lifesaver!
...Huh? Jump in the water after this? Hmm... I'm feeling lazy, but I did skip it last time, so... Alright, let's do it!
Actually, drifting off while the waves rock me sounds pretty nice too.
Ahahaha, okay, now I'm actually getting hyped!
Summer and this live aren't over yet, okay? Let’s enjoy every last bit of it together!
Hm? My swimsuit? You think it suits me? Ahaha, thanks~
Alright, time to go floating. I’m gonna grab a serious nap on my floatie while the waves rock me back and forth!
Wait, scratch that. I'll take this one instead. It looks way better for napping.
The sun is so warm and the ocean feels great... It's the perfect balance... I could totally pass out right now...
*yawn* Okay, let's get moving. Once we're back on the beach, let's take a nap.

Bang bang! Hehe, successful headshot!
Were you gazing at fireworks? You left yourself wide open.
Who would've thought the water blaster target practice would come in handy so soon?
...How long do you plan on crawling around down there?
Do you maybe wanna go swimming at the night pool?
Hehe, no problem to have quirky tastes, but aren’t you missing the point of how to enjoy this place?
Fine, I suppose I have no choice but give you a special lesson. Now, let's make this a night to remember~♪
Ready to drown in romance tonight? Of course you are, right?
You don’t need to ask if sunglasses are necessary at night. They’re total nonsense! Of course not, they’re not.
The night pool is great because you won’t get attacked by a laser weapon. Oh, I mean sunlight.
Both people and insects are drawn to magical lights.
*gasp* Splashing water on a maiden is prison worthy!
Everyone comes here seeking a special time. It was special, for me especially.
Nope. Nobody's sleeping on my watch!
Who wants to dance with me until we're drenched in sweat together?
Beat the heat...and feast your eyes upon me!
Summer's finally here~! Time to get aaaabsolutely wild!
Nothing beats an air conditioner during summer!
I only have one thing to say... Summer is here, go wild!
I’ll sign my name with a water blaster!♪
Welcome to a magical night. Now, let's have fun!♪
If you're okay with my oil, I'll rub some on you, Aki-chan~♪
ERROR. Swimsuit too stimulating. OVERHEATING NOW.
That's definitely not the kind of oil you're supposed to rub on someone's skin~
Hmm? Looks like my swimsuit slipped a bit... Robocosan? You OK there?
Even in this scorching heat, its my job to bring healing~♡
Is anyone falling for my swimsuit around here?
The season when barley juice tastes the best is finally heeere!
Oh my~♡ Tell them there's no need to hold back~♪
Tis' fiiiine! Just go ahead and fall head over heels for me.♡
How to add a splash of color to summer you say? Leave it to me.♪
As expected of a true healing specialist! You go, girl!
Everyone's saying they don't know where to look, Aki-chan.
Yes, yes, yes, yes! Right here! Aki-chan, you're the beeest!
That's an almost illegal dose of sexy you're packing there! HOWAAAA!
Bear witness to summer-me, too! Here~♪
What is wrong with your head?
Shine that spotlight! Anya-sama is making her entrance!
Eh? What? I-If you eat too much watermelon...it’ll grow again in your stomach!
Look, Anya~♪ My forehead is covered in sweat!
Yaaay! Yaaay! What a sore loser~♪
I'm getting the urge to spray you with my water gun~♪
La+! Don't point the hose at the audience seats!
Yeah yeah! I get it, I totally get it!
Everyone's eyes will turn into hearts if they catch a glance of your swimsuit!
I've certainly "witnessed" enough of you! Thanks for the meal!
For reals?! Please spray me until I'm a soaking wet mess!
AZKi-san~ I've stripped down just for you!
I'll soak every last one of you! Ahahaha!
Irohaaa~ It's sooo hot! I need a drink now!
Heh. Everyone's fallen prey to my swimsuit!
Anyone who's late will be punished!
Nah, I'm good. I don't accept anyone lower than SSS Tier on my Big Sis Tier list.
Follow me! Those pesky humans are exhausted by the heat so...it's the perfect chance to enact WORLD DOMINATION!
Get it yourself... You can't even do that? Fine, here you go.
Don't fall behind, and remember to have fun!
Heeey there! Entering the scene with a new shiny swimsuit... It’s-a me, Anya Melfissa!
Got ya covered! Let me cool you off with my portable fan!
Alright then, here’s a fun summer one-liner from Fu-tan! Go ahead!
BWAHAHA! Who’s stronger now, sun? I’ve got sunglasses!
At the beach, we've gotta have Ina-yaki, right~
Check out this scarf. Pretty stylish, right?
Anyone who doesn't? Straight into the sea they go~
Oh, so this is the kind of swimsuit that you like, huh?
Summer and this live aren't over yet, okay? Let’s enjoy every last bit of it together!
Shiori, you got some nice catches!
The swimsuit episodes are always peak...
You’re so cool~ I wanna copy you.
All right, Shiorin! Let's do it in style!
Huh?! Hey, quit with the unreasonable demands!!
Ina-yaki...? ...Huh, I am not a Tako!
Everyone, make sure to hydrate when you're sweating a lot, okay?
Nice! You can do some watermelon smashing using that blindfold!
Whew-woo! Your swimsuit doesn't leave much to the imagination, does it, Anya?
Heh. Right? How does it compare to ancient weapons?
Are you gonna play secret agents?
Okay! Set off some fireworks to get the party started!♪
Swimsuit Shiori~♪ Hehe, what do you think?
This gun barrel is aiming right for you girls.
This is what you wanted, Rissa? Have a taste!
Oh, so it’s not just the mosquitoes that are gunning for my skin.
Ready to drown in romance tonight? Of course you are, right?
Shiori, could you show off your swimsuit a little more?
Pfffffttt!!! LapLap-tan's swimsuit looks like a kid's~♪
LapLap-tan! Want me to put sunscreen on you?
The Best Way to Spend Summer♪
